description: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for six different models – mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂ – across seven language families. The horizontal axis represents language family, with labels including “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each language family, there are six bars, one for each model, colored green, blue, red, brown, light blue, and dark blue respectively. Each bar is accompanied by an error bar extending vertically from both ends. The shortest bars are generally associated with the “Isolate” language family, with values around 1-3 for most models, while the tallest bars are found for the “IE-Germanic” family, reaching approximately 22-26 for some models. The bars are grouped by language family, with each model represented by a bar within that group. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
